title: Introducing 3 Putt Bogey
summary: Trailer/introduction for the new golf comedy podcast "3 Putt Bogey," presented by Josh and Chuck (the transcript names them as Chuck Bryan and Adam Pranica in the opening lines). The hosts explain the show's premise: golfers who occasionally hit two good shots in a row but rarely three, with the three-putt bogey as the signature meltdown. They say episodes come out every Friday morning for weekend golf routines, cover the absurdity and frustration of golf, and include personal golf updates: one host plays weekly casual rounds in Atlanta and shoots in the low to mid 90s, the other plays club tournaments in Los Angeles. The episode closes with a teaser about a golf club wrapped in plastic wrap and painter's tape at a driving range. Available on the iHeart podcast app.
